mechanism_narrative: A low effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 650000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-recession recovery regime, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 310 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 310, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and housing starts (HOUST > 1300) indicates a broad-based economic recovery, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO > 100 and HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 700000) indicates strong consumer demand that may lead to overheating and policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during the late-cycle expansion regime when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
